newsitem.title: FRANCE: French leaders' standing declines in December - poll.
newsitem.headline: French leaders' standing declines in December - poll.

text.p: Public confidence French President Jacques Chirac and his embattled Prime Minister Alain Juppe fell again this month, an opinion poll issued on Wednesday showed.
The Ifop poll, to be published on Thursday by the weekly news magazine L'Express, showed 44 percent of 944 people questioned trusted Chirac as a leader, down from 46 percent last month.
Juppe's standing dropped to 31 percent from 34 percent. Those who did not trust him rose to 67 percent from 65.
The poll was released on the eve of a rare 90-minute television interview scheduled by Chirac in a bid to restore public confidence in his faltering conservative goverment.
